articles.title: Road closure for Wardle Village Carol Concert on 24 December 2026
articles.excerpt: Ramsden Road in Wardle will be temporarily closed on 24 December 2026 from 5.30pm to 7.30pm for the Wardle Village Carol Concert. The closure will affect the section of Ramsden Road between its junctions with Crossfield Road and Wardle Fold, with no alternative route available for vehicles during this time.
articles.content_html:
Ramsden Road in Wardle will be temporarily closed on 24 December 2026 from 5.30pm to 7.30pm for the Wardle Village Carol Concert.

The closure will affect the section of Ramsden Road between its junctions with Crossfield Road and Wardle Fold, with no alternative route available for vehicles during this time.

A spokesperson from Rochdale Borough Council confirmed the details of the closure, emphasising the importance of ensuring safety during the event.

Residents and visitors are advised to plan their journeys accordingly and can view a map of roadworks across Greater Manchester for further information.

Rochdale Borough Council - Roadworks Information: www.rochdale.gov.uk/directory-record/2657/wardle-village-carol-concert-road-closure-in-wardle-on-24-december-2026

articles.title: Road closures for Wardle Remembrance Sunday on 8 November 2026
articles.excerpt: Rochdale Borough Council has announced road closures in Wardle for Remembrance Sunday on 8 November 2026, affecting local traffic and access.
articles.content_html:
Rochdale Borough Council has announced that there will be road closures in Wardle on 8 November 2026, in observance of Remembrance Sunday. These closures are part of the annual events to honour those who have served in the armed forces.

Details on the specific roads affected have not yet been provided, but residents and visitors are advised to plan their journeys accordingly to avoid disruptions.

This event is significant for the local community, offering a chance to pay tribute to veterans and those who have lost their lives in service. The council encourages participation in the ceremonies, which foster community spirit and remembrance.

For the latest updates on road closures and any diversions, residents can check the Rochdale Borough Council website.
